def path(value):
    value = str(value).replace('\\', '/')
    if value.startswith('E:/'):
        value = '/mnt/e/' + value[3:]
    elif value.startswith('//wsl.localhost/Debian/'):
        value = '/' + value[len('//wsl.localhost/Debian/'):]
    result = Path(value)
    return result if result.is_absolute() else ROOT / result

def sha(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(path(value).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def read(value):
    assert path(value).suffix == '.json', str(value)
    return json.loads(path(value).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

def exact(value, digest):
    assert sha(value) == digest, str(value)
    return read(value)
